propositions: The file-backed bridge-status implementation and purge-bridge command were removed in commit 318903aa37 and must remain absent.
A hidden bridge-status compatibility alias now routes to canonical durable bridge status via the parser, remaining absent from top-level help.
The durable bridge_status schema, Python facade BridgeStatus type, MCP bridge_status tool/model, and all generator registries must remain intact and functional.
The BRIDGE_STATUS export, constant, and OUTPUT_SCHEMAS bridge_status entry must be removed from the schema registry alongside the schema file.
Read warnings in reads_cli.py and output.py must be updated to provide neutral bridge-alert guidance without referencing retired or unreleased commands.
Both rebar bridge-status and rebar purge-bridge must exit as unknown commands and appear nowhere in shipped package src/rebar or active docs (cli-reference.md, exit-codes.md, output-schemas.md).
